subject: Starlake Annual Renewal — PO & Tax Forms
messages:
From: Starlake Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@starlake.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Starlake Annual Renewal — PO & Tax Forms

Hi Soojin,

We received the renewal notice for our Redwood Inference subscription (renewal effective 2027-10-15). Finance needs to confirm a couple of billing items before we can route the PO:  

- Can Redwood accept a PO with Net60 terms? Our AP runs on Net60 for platform contracts.
- Please confirm the exact vendor name and address to put on the PO (legal entity + tax ID).
- We also need Redwood's W-9 for our records.

I've attached a draft PO reflecting the 20% seat increase (see attachment). Please confirm any changes and provide the billing contact that our team should include on remittance communications.

Thanks,

Emma Li
Director, Finance Operations
Starlake Analytics
accounts-payable@starlake.ai
Attachment: Starlake_PO_2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@starlake.ai>, accounts-payable@starlake.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starlake Annual Renewal — PO & Tax Forms

Emma — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO. We're excited to continue supporting Starlake and the additional capacity. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Net60: We can accommodate Net60 for this renewal. We'll reflect Net60 in the amendment and acceptance flow tied to the existing deal (DL-2027-0789).
- Vendor name & address: Could you confirm the legal payee name and the EIN exactly as it should appear on the PO? We need the exact string to avoid AP rejections.
- W-9: Our billing team will attach Redwood's W-9 and provide the remittance/billing contact details.

Marissa / Neha — looping you in to issue Redwood's W-9 and confirm the remittance email and invoice cadence. Marissa, please confirm whether we should accept the attached PO as-is or attach an amendment signing link (DocuSign). If we proceed with DocuSign, please share the link and any invoice milestones (e.g., annual up-front vs. monthly invoicing).

Emma — once we have the confirmed payee/EIN we can return a countersigned PO or send a DocuSign amendment for signature. If you want us to email invoices to a specific AP mailbox, include that address in your reply.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@starlake.ai>, accounts-payable@starlake.ai
Date: 2027-09-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starlake Annual Renewal — PO & Tax Forms

Thanks for looping me in, Soojin.

We can provide Redwood's W-9 and vendor remittance details immediately. A couple of internal notes / asks: 

- Please confirm the legal payee string (as it should appear on the invoice/PO). We need the exact name and EIN to match AP expectations.
- For Net60, we'll create an amendment that references the original SOW and includes the Net60 payment term. The amendment will be routed via DocuSign; prefer to send to the signing contact on file (Emma).
- Invoice cadence: default is monthly in arrears unless the customer selects annual upfront. If Starlake wants the invoice split or a milestone schedule tied to the 20% capacity bump, tell us the preferred cadence.

I've attached our current W-9 for your procurement team to include in their vendor file.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Emma Li <emma.li@starlake.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starlake Annual Renewal — PO & Tax Forms

Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the quick responses. Per AP: 

- Legal payee: Starlake Analytics, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789 (please use exactly this string on the PO)
- We've signed and attached the PO with the 20% seat increase and Net60 term.
- Attached our W-9 for your records.

Please send the DocuSign amendment to me (emma.li@starlake.ai) so I can complete the countersignature. Also confirm the invoice schedule: we prefer monthly invoices, but if you require annual invoicing for the capacity uplift please let us know.

Thanks,

Emma Li
Director, Finance Operations
Starlake Analytics
Attachment: Starlake_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
